scripts.build:native: cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p creel-shell --lib && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p creel-desktop-host
scripts.build:native:release: cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p creel-shell --lib && cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p creel-desktop-host
scripts.tauri:before-dev: npm run build:native && npm run dev
scripts.tauri:before-build: npm run build:native:release && npm run build
